fields.name: service_key
fields.help: 공공데이터포털 (data.go.kr) 일반 인증키 (Decoding) for 조달청_나라장터 입찰공고정보서비스 (dataset 15129394), issued after an 활용신청.

adapter.terms: Korea Public Data Portal open API (조달청). Bidding on KONEPS/나라장터 requires Korean G2B supplier registration.

search_postings.note: 나라장터검색조건에 의한 입찰공고용역조회 (services tenders): inqryDiv=1 (공고게시일시) over the last 30 days (inqryBgnDt/inqryEndDt 'YYYYMMDDHHMM'), bidNtceNm = query (입찰공고명), presmptPrceBgn = min_budget (추정가격, KRW), bidClseExcpYn=Y (입찰마감제외여부: leave out closed bids). XML response (response.body.items.item); totalCount is text so total is null. presmptPrce (추정가격), asignBdgtAmt, ntceInsttNm (공고기관), bidNtceOrd (차수), opengDt and the spec document URLs stay in raw (numbers are strings in the XML). A portal-level error (e.g. SERVICE_KEY_IS_NOT_REGISTERED_ERROR) answers an OpenAPI_ServiceResponse document instead, so postings is empty — check raw via get_posting if in doubt.

get_posting.note: 입찰공고목록 정보에 대한 용역조회 with inqryDiv=2 (입찰공고번호) and bidNtceNo = id (e.g. R25BK00934017); returns the first 차수. Services tenders only (goods/works use other operations).

not_offered.me: The portal key has no account/introspection operation in this service.
not_offered.submit_bid: Bids (투찰) are made in 나라장터 with a registered supplier certificate; the open API is read-only.
not_offered.bid_status: Read-only open API; bid results are a separate service (낙찰정보서비스) not mapped here.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging in the open API.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging in the open API.
not_offered.credits: The portal's daily call quota is shown only in the data.go.kr mypage; no API.

evidence: host apis.data.go.kr: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
